sn35.237:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave cakkhusmiṃ sati cakkhu samphassapaccayā uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ. sotasmiṃ …pe… ghānasmiṃ …pe…
sn35.237:1.7: manasmiṃ sati manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ.
sn35.237:2.1: hatthesu bhikkhave asati ādānanikkhepanaṃ na hoti,
sn35.237:2.3: pabbesu asati sammiñjana pasāraṇaṃ na hoti,
sn35.237:2.4: kucchismiṃ asati jighacchā pipāsā na hoti.
sn35.237:2.5: evameva kho bhikkhave cakkhusmiṃ asati cakkhusamphassapaccayā nūppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ. sotasmiṃ asati …pe… ghānasmiṃ asati …pe…
sn35.237:2.7: manasmiṃ asati manosamphassapaccayā nūppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
